title: Relay Logic
user: Solo logic-puzzle players who want a fresh daily puzzle that teaches its rule set by play instead of making them decode a tutorial.

evidence.quote_or_summary: Witstep launches free no-signup daily math and logic patterns, confirming current browser appetite for daily non-word puzzles.
Gridmino offers ad-free daily logic variants including Dicesweep and Kakumino, showing makers are actively searching for twists on established logic games.
Fetched Witstep page is titled 'Think in steps,' corroborating a live daily logic-puzzle browser category.

recurrence: Two new August 2026 launches target free daily logic puzzles, a clear pattern of demand and a signal that differentiation must be in onboarding rather than another clone.
current_workaround: Learn a dense rule sheet for a niche puzzle or play familiar Minesweeper/Kakuro variants.
incumbents_and_gap: Witstep and Gridmino provide collections and variants; a single progressive puzzle can make deduction approachable through reversible micro-actions.
smallest_useful_product: A daily circuit-routing board with 3-5 colored signals. Players place one relay at a time; immediate local feedback teaches the constraint without revealing the solution. Runs are 3-8 minutes and daily seeds change topology. Non-goals: electricity education claims, puzzle editor, timed ads, or account streaks.
success_measure: 75% of new players finish the three-board learn-by-doing sequence and 30% attempt the next daily board.
monetization: free — an ad-free daily page is the credible alternative to cluttered puzzle portals.
constraints: Every generated board must be solver-checked for a unique solution and accessible with keyboard/colorblind shapes.
why_distinct: The game teaches one novel logic system through feedback rather than selling a pile of renamed classics.
